title: DON'T LET THE ENEMY SPEAK FIRST — POWERFUL MORNING PRAYERS
text: Beloved, some of you came here today with heaviness. You came with questions. You came with uncertainty about the week ahead. I want you to know that before you stepped into this place, God had already written your name in the palms of his hands. The enemy has been strategizing. Yes, but the almighty has been orchestrating. Let me tell you what the spirit of God is saying right now. There is power in sequence. There is authority in precedence. When you wake up tomorrow morning, before your feet touch that floor, before you think about your problems, before the day can announce its plans for your life, someone needs to understand this. The words you speak carry weight. The declarations you make carry creative force. I'm looking at somebody here right now who has been losing battles in the morning. You wake up and immediately the enemy is speaking. You won't make it today. that promotion isn't for you. Your marriage is over. Your body is failing and all day you are fighting [clears throat] uphill because the enemy got the the first word. He got precedence in your consciousness. But I came to tell you today that this changes now. The siege is broken. The first word belongs to you because you belong to God. Turn to Proverbs 23 and:e7. As a man thinks in his heart, so is he. Do you understand what this is telling you? Your thoughts precede your reality. Your confession precedes your condition. Your words are architects. They are building your tomorrow. And if the enemy gets the first word in your spirit in the morning, he's building your defeat while you are still half asleep. Let me take you to Proverbs 18 20 and 21. A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth, and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled. Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof. Listen to me carefully. The power of your tongue is not theoretical. It is not sentimental. [music] It is covenant power. It is creative force. Your words are alive. They are working. They are active whether you believe it or not. So when you wake up tomorrow, the very first authority you exercise is the authority of speech. Not the enemy speech, your speech. You are the authorized voice in your life. You are the spokesperson of your destiny. Not your enemy, not your circumstances, not your past. You I can feel the Holy Ghost here. Somebody's getting free tonight. Somebody's understanding for the first time that they have been giving the enemy too much platform. [music] The enemy has been speaking your future and you have been living it out like it is written in stone. But I came to tell you the script is changing. [music] Your declaration is changing. The authority is shifting back to you. Let me go to Romans 10:17. So then faith cometh by hearing and hearing by the word of God. But listen, there is another dimension. Your faith is strengthened by what you hear. So if the first thing you hear in the morning is your own defeated voice, you are feeling defeat. If the first voice you hear is despair, you are planting despair. But if the first voice, the first word, the first authority you exercise is the voice of faith. I declare healing. I declare blessing. I declare divine favor. You are setting the atmosphere. You are speaking destiny into being. There is something that happens in the morning that does not happen at any other time. In those moments when you are transitioning from rest into activity, from sleep into consciousness, your spirit is most receptive. The veil is thin. Heaven is closed. The enemy knows this. That is why he attacks in the morning. That is why thoughts come. That is why fear arrives. That is why doubt whispers because he wants that first word. He wants that first authority. But I'm here to tell you that no longer. Look at Psalm 5:es 1-3. Give ear to my words, O Lord. Consider my meditation. Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my king and my God, for unto thee will I pray. My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up. David understood the power of the morning word. He understood that the first voice in the morning determines the trajectory of your entire day. There is a principle in the kingdom. First fruit carries blessing. The first word carries authority. The first move carries momentum. This is why you must move before the enemy. This is why you must speak before the enemy speaks. This is why your prayer, your declaration, your authority must preede the day. Now listen to what is happening. Many of you wake up and the first thing you do is check your phone. You see the news. [music] You see the messages. You see the problems. You see the negativity. And the enemy has already spoken. By the time you are fully conscious, the enemy has painted the day with his brush. He has colored your expectations with his palette. But I came to interrupt this pattern. Before your feet hit the floor, there must be a declaration. There must be a [music] prayer. There must be an exercise of authority. You say, "Apostle, what should I pray?" The spirit is going to teach you. But let me give you the foundation. You pray like this. I declare this day belongs to the Lord. I declare that no evil shall come near me. I declare that my steps are ordered of the Lord. I declare that I walk in divine favor. I declare that my enemies are confused. I declare that my destiny is protected. I declare that nothing can separate me from the purpose of God. I declare that I am the head and not the tail. I declare that the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the enemy speaks. Do you understand? You are not just praying, you are declaring. You are not just speaking words. You are speaking kingdom law. You are establishing order. You are creating the framework within which the day must operate. Let me take you to Isaiah 43:es 1 and 2. But now thus sayeth the Lord that created thee, oh Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, fear not, for I have redeemed thee. I have called thee by thy name. Thou art mine. When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee, and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee. When thou walst through the fire, thou shalt not be burned. Neither shall the flame kindle upon thee. This is the word of God. This is the truth. That must be the first word in your consciousness. Fear not. I have called you by name. You are mine. When you walk through this day, you do not walk alone. The armies of God are with you. The Holy Ghost is with you. Angels are assigned to you. Demons tremble at your name because you are bloodbought. You are covenant property. You belong to God. So when the enemy tries to speak fear in your morning, you say, "But the Lord says fear not." When the enemy tries to speak abandonment, you say, "But the Lord says, I have called you by name and you are mine." When the enemy tries to speak failure, you say, "But the Lord says, I am redeemed." Do you see what is happening? You are not fighting the enemy with weakness. You are not trying to believe positive thoughts to combat negative thoughts. You are invoking the word and the authority of God. You are bringing heaven's law into your morning. You are establishing the kingdom of God in your consciousness before the day begins. Let me move deeper into this. There are dimensions to what I'm sharing that your mind has not yet grasped. The enemy does not just speak words. The enemy speaks causes. The enemy speaks covenants. When he speaks over you in the morning through your own thoughts, through circumstances, through people, he's making covenants with the day. He's establishing altars in the atmosphere above your life. He's speaking assignments to demons. He's programming principalities and powers to walk against you throughout the day. But when you pray before your feet hit the floor, you are breaking those covenants. You are dismantling those altars. You are changing the assignment over your life. You are programming the kingdom of God to work for you. You are speaking to angels, not demons. You are speaking to your blessing, not your cause. Turn to Proverbs 6:es 1-5. My son, if thou be shorty for thy friend, if thou has stricken thy hand with a stranger, thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth, do this now, my son, and deliver thyself. When thou had come into the hand of thy friend, go humble thyself, and make sure thy friend. Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids. Deliver thyself as a roar from the hand of the hunter and as a bird from the hand of the fowler. Listen to me. You can be snared by words. By words. Not just your own words, but words that have been spoken over you. Words that you have agreed with. Words that you have meditated on. The enemy's strategy is this. Speak the word. Get you to agree with the word. Get you to meditate on the word. Get you to speak the word yourself. And then that word has power. That word becomes law in your life. But here is what I am telling you. Before you agree with anything, before you accept anything, before you meditate on anything, you declare the truth of God, you establish the kingdom reality before you even encounter the enemy's reality. Psalm 91:1 says, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways." The angels are waiting for a decree. They are waiting for a word. When you speak in the morning and declare your protection, declare your blessing, declare your victory, you are giving angels something to do. You are releasing them to walk on your behalf. You are activating the power of heaven on your behalf. But if the enemy speaks first, if he gets the first word, the angels are standing down because there is no counter command. There is no decree from the authorized party you. So the enemy's assignments go unchallenged, the enemy's words go uncontested, and the whole day you are playing defense. I am shifting the paradigm right now. You are not going to be on defense anymore. Starting tomorrow morning, you are going to be on offense. You are going to move first. You are going to speak first. You are going to declare first. And the enemy will be responding to you, not you responding to the enemy. Let me take you to Joshua 1:es 8 and 9. This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth, but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein. For then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success. Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage. Be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed, for the Lord thy God is with thee, whethersoever thou goest. Do you understand what Joshua is being told? Meditation on the word produces prosperity. Meditation on the word produces success. But it requires that the word not depart from your mouth. You must speak it. You must declare it. You must give it life. So your morning declaration is not just nice words. It is not just positive thinking. It is meditation on the law of God. It is bringing the promises of God into your consciousness. It is establishing the truth of God in your spirit before the day can bring the lies of the enemy. There is something I want to emphasize. The words you speak in the [music] morning have a different weight than what spoken later in the day. The morning is the launch. The morning is the foundation. The morning is where momentum is created. So if you speak defeat in the morning, the whole day is built on defeat. But if you speak victory in the morning, the whole day is built on [music] victory. If you speak limitation in the morning, the whole day is structured by limitation. But if you speak abundance in the morning, the whole day flows in abundance. This is why the enemy fights for your morning. This is why the enemy wants to steal your sleep. This is why the enemy wants to create anxiety before your feet hit the floor. He knows what I'm telling you. He knows that the first word is the sovereign word. Let me give you another scripture. Deuteronomy 28:es 1-4. And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments, which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth, and all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou [clears throat] shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God. Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field. [music] Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kind, and the flocks of thy sheep. The principle is clear. Harkening determines blessing. What you listen to determines your blessing. What you agree with determines your path. So in the morning, you must hearken unto the voice of the Lord. You must agree with God. You must listen to his word. And the moment you do, blessings overtake you. That is the promise. But if in the morning you hearken onto the voice of despair, you agree with defeat. You listen to the enemy's narrative. Then causes overtake you. Not because God causes you, but because you have agreed with the cause. You have entered covenant with the cause. You have meditated on the cause. And by the law of creation, by what you speak, so shall it be. the curse comes to pass. Now, I want you to understand something. The prayer before your feet hits the floor is not a prayer of desperation. It is not a prayer of begging. It is a prayer of authority. It is a decree. It is a declaration. You are not asking God to bless you. He has already blessed you. You are not asking God to protect you. He has already protected you. You are declaring what is already yours. You are establishing in the natural what is already true in the spirit. This is what the apostle Paul understood. Look at Ephesians 1:es 3 and 4. Blessed be the God and father of our Lord Jesus Christ who had blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ according as he had chosen us in him before the foundation of the world that we should be holy and without blame before him in love. Listen, you are already blessed in the heavenly places in the spirit. You are already complete. You are already victorious. You are already equipped. You are already chosen. You are already covered. So in the morning, what you are doing is bringing that spiritual reality into the natural realm. You are translating heaven's blessing into earth's experience. You are speaking what is already true in the kingdom into what must become true in the natural. This is why your words have power. This is not positive psychology. This is not manifestation. This is not new age thinking. This is kingdom reality. You are not trying to create something that is not you are declaring something that is already in the spirit realm and calling it into the natural realm. When you say I declare healing over my body, you are not creating healing. God has already made a way for your healing through the blood of Jesus and the stripes of Jesus. You are declaring what is already purchased and releasing it into your body. When you say, "I declare abundance," you are not creating abundance. God has already made a way for abundance through covenant. You are declaring what is already your inheritance and releasing it into your circumstances. When you say, "I declare my enemies are confused." You are not making them confused. The blood of Jesus has already separated them from their assignment. You are declaring what is already true and bringing it into manifestation. Do you understand the difference? You are not creating reality through your words. You are translating reality. You are moving the kingdom of God from the invisible realm into the visible realm through your declaration. Let me take you to Hebrews 11:3. Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God. So that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear. Everything you see was spoken into existence. The word preceded the manifestation. The declaration came before the creation. So when you speak in the morning, you are following the pattern of God. You are using the language of creation. You are operating in the power by which all things were made. This is why the enemy fights for your morning word. This is why he wants you to wake up and think about your problems before you think about your God. He wants to establish the problem as your reality. He wants you to speak the problem into permanence. But I came to interrupt this cycle. Starting today, starting tomorrow morning, you are going to move differently. You are going to pray differently. You are going to speak differently. Before your feet hit the floor, you are going to establish the lordship of Christ. Before your feet hit the floor, you are going to declare the protection of the blood. Before your feet hit the floor, you are going to speak your blessing into the day. Before your feet hit the floor, you are going to break every curse that has been spoken. Before your feet hit the floor, you are going to set the tone, set the atmosphere, and set your victory. Now, let me move into the warfare dimension of what I'm sharing. Listen carefully. There are forces that are designed to oppose your morning. There are demonic assignments that are designed to steal your peace before your feet hit the floor. There are covenants that have been established over your life through words spoken by others, through curses from your bloodline, through agreements you have made. And if you do not counter this with the authority of the morning word, they will operate throughout your day. Let me take you to Ephesians 6 10-12. Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord and [music] in the power of his might. Put on the whole armor of God that ye may be able to stand against the ws of the devil. For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. Paul is telling you that the battle is not physical. The battle is spiritual. You are not fighting people. [music] You are fighting powers. You are not wrestling with circumstances. You are wrestling with principalities. [music] And the moment you understand this, you understand why your morning word is so critical. You are not just starting your day. You are taking ground. You are engaging in warfare. You are fighting for the integrity of your destiny. Now, many of you wake up in the morning and you feel heaviness. You feel oppression. You feel like something is pressing down on your spirit. That is not your imagination. That is warfare. That is demonic pressure. That is an assignment designed to steal your money. And if you respond to it by lying in bed and meditating on the problem, you are giving the enemy more ground. But if you respond by standing up, speaking your authority, declaring your victory, you are pushing back. You are taking ground. Let me give you the reality. In the spirit realm, there are demons assigned to you. I'm not trying to frighten you. I'm speaking the truth of scripture. Ephesians 6 tells you that you wrestle against principalities and powers. That means there are intelligent forces working against you. That means there are assignments. That means there is strategy. But here is what the enemy does not want you to know. You have authority over these forces. You do not have authority based on your own power. You have authority based on the blood of Jesus. You have authority based on the name of Jesus. You have authority based on the covenant of God. And when you invoke that authority in the morning, demons must obey. When you stand up and declare, I plead the blood of Jesus over my mind, my body, and my spirit. Demons do not argue. They cannot argue. The blood of Jesus is final. The blood of Jesus is authority. The blood of Jesus is law in the spirit realm. When you declare every evil assignment against my life is broken, you are not speaking as a human. You are speaking [music] as a representative of the kingdom of God. And the kingdom of God has authority over all the kingdoms of darkness. [music] This is what I want you to understand. The morning prayer is not soft. The morning prayer is warfare. The morning prayer is aggressive. The morning prayer is taking ground. The morning prayer is dismantling the assignments of the enemy. I see somebody here who has been prayed for. You have been to ministry. You have fasted. You have done the outward things. But nobody has taught you that your own morning declaration is one of the most powerful weapons in your arsenal. Your own morning word is the decree that changes your day. Your own authority invoked in the morning is what shifts the atmosphere. [music] Let me take you to Colossians 1 13 and 14. who had delivered us from the power of darkness and had translated us into the kingdom of his dear son in whom we have redemption through his blood even the forgiveness of sins. Listen to what this is saying. You have been translated from the kingdom of darkness into the kingdom of light. You are not fighting for victory. You are fighting from victory. The translation has already happened. The deliverance has already been accomplished. You are walking in what is already true. So when you pray in the morning, you are not trying to get victory. You are enforcing victory. You are not trying to get deliverance. You are maintaining deliverance. You are not trying to get transferred from darkness to light. You are living as one who has already been transferred. This is the posture. This is the authority. This is why your morning word is so powerful. You are standing in a position that is already secured by the blood of Jesus. You are declaring what is already true. You are maintaining what has already been won. Now, let me teach you about the enemy's counter strategy. The enemy knows this. The enemy knows that your morning word is critical. So, here is what the enemy does. The enemy tries to keep you from sleeping well so that when you wake up, you are groggy, confused, and vulnerable. The enemy tries to flood you with thoughts the moment you wake up so that your consciousness is hijacked before you can pray. The enemy tries to make you feel so oppressed that your faith is shaken. This is why many of you wake up with anxiety. This is not your health. This is spiritual warfare. This is the enemy trying to capture your morning consciousness. But I'm teaching you a new response. When you wake up and feel the oppression, that is your signal to move into prayer. When you wake up and the thoughts are heavy, that is your moment to declare your authority. When you wake up and you feel the pressure, that is your opportunity to exercise the power of the blood of Jesus. Do not wait until you have conquered the oppression to pray. Pray while you are in the oppression. Let your prayer be your warfare. Let your declaration be your deliverance. Let your morning word be your victory. Let me give you another scripture. 1 Peter 5:8. Be sober. Be vigilant. Because your adversary, the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about seeking whom he may devour. The enemy is seeking. The enemy is looking. The enemy is hunting. And the moment you wake up, the hunt is on. The enemy is looking to see if you are conscious. The enemy is looking to see if you are going to exercise your authority. The enemy is looking to see if you are going to pray. But here is what happens when you wake up and immediately pray. [music] The enemy discovers that you are awake. The enemy discovers that you are conscious. The enemy discovers that you are exercising authority. And at that moment, the hunt ends because the prey is no longer defenseless. The prey has turned into a warrior. This is the shift I want you to make. You are not prey. You are a warrior. You are not a victim of the enemy's assignments. You are an enforcer of the kingdom of God. Now, let me move into what I want you to declare. The spirit is directing me to give you specific words. These are not just nice statements. These are declarations of power. When you say these words in the morning, you are invoking the power of heaven on your behalf. First declare this. I cover myself with the blood of Jesus. Say that the blood of Jesus is not symbolic. The blood of Jesus is active power. The blood of Jesus speaks. The blood of Jesus protects. [music] The blood of Jesus separates. When you cover yourself with the blood, you are invoking a force that is more powerful than all the darkness combined. Second, declare this. Every assignment against my life is broken in the name of Jesus. [music] This is specific. You are not just asking God. You are declaring that the assignments are broken. You are using your authority to sever the connection between the assignment and your life. Third, declare this. My enemies are confused and scattered in the name of Jesus. This is prophetic. This is invoking the angel of the Lord to come against your enemies. This is speaking destruction to the assignments of darkness. Fourth, declare this. I walk in divine favor and supernatural promotion. This is declaration of blessing. This is speaking the blessing of God into your circumstances. Fifth, declare this. My steps are ordered of the Lord and my paths are established. This is establishing divine direction. You are declaring that you do not walk by accident. You do not move by chance. Your path is divinely ordered. Sixth, declare this. The power of the blood of Jesus is released in my family today. This is extending the blessing to your loved ones. This is using your authority to protect those you love. Seven, declare this. every gate of blessing is open to me today. This is declaring access. This is declaring that the doors of opportunity are open. This is declaring that abundance has a clear path to your life. Eight, declare this. No evil shall come near my habitation and my family. This is protection. This is using your authority to establish a hedge around your home. Ninth, declare this. I am the head and not the tail, above and not beneath. This is positioning. This is declaring that you are not subordinate to your circumstances. You are not beneath the enemy. You are above all spiritual forces. 10. Declare this. My destiny is sealed. My glory is hidden with Christ in God. And nothing can separate me from the purpose of the Almighty. This is finality. This is declaring that your destiny is not negotiable. Your purpose is not dependent on circumstances. These are not the only declarations. The Holy Ghost will give you more, but these are the foundation. These are the declarations that shift the atmosphere. These are the declarations that establish your authority before your feet hit the floor. Now, let me teach you something else. The timing matters. You do not just declare these things. You declare them with authority. You declare them with conviction. You declare them like you believe them. Because if you speak them as if you are asking a question, the enemy will answer the question. But if you speak them as a declaration, the enemy has no choice but to obey. This is the difference between prayer and decree. In prayer, you ask. In a decree, you command. In a prayer, you appeal to authority. In a decree, you exercise authority. Both are valid. But in the morning, the moment you wake up, what you need is decree. What you need is the exercise of authority. So you stand up or you sit on the edge of your bed and you speak these declarations like you are the authority in your own life because you are you are the steward of your own destiny. You are the representative of the kingdom of God in your life. You have the authority to decree what shall happen. Let me take you to Proverbs 23:es 1-3. When thou sitest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee. For thou putest a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite, be not desirous of his dainties, for they are deceitful meat. Listen, Solomon is teaching about eating with a ruler. But there is a deeper truth. You are sitting down for a meal with God every morning. The table is spread before you. The feast is prepared. But you must approach this meal with order. You must understand the nature of what you are engaging in. When you pray in the morning, you are approaching the throne of God. You are having audience with the King of Kings. You are coming before the one who has all authority. And when you do this with understanding, when you do this with reverence, when you do this with the expectation that God is listening and responding, the power is multiplied. This is why many prayers go unanswered. It is not that God is not listening. It is that you are not praying with understanding. You are not praying with authority. You are not praying like you expect to be heard. But when you stand up in the morning and you declare your authority, when you speak like you expect obedience, when you decree like the throne of God is backing you up, the powers of darkness must respond. I want to shift now into the specific warfare prayers that you need to be praying. I want to move into the dimensions that will dismantle every assignment against your life. I want to enter into the intercession that changes your destiny. Listen to me. The prayer section is where the real power is released. The teaching is the foundation. The declarations are the framework. But the prayer is where the power flows. This is where the angels are engaged. This is where the blood of Jesus is activated. This is where your destiny is protected and advanced. [clears throat] So settle yourself. Get into a place of faith because what I am about to pray is not just words. These are declarations of warfare. These are invocations of power. And if you agree with this in your spirit, if you say yes in your heart, you are releasing power that will change your entire trajectory. Father, we come before you in the name of Jesus Christ. We come in the authority of the blood. We come as representatives of the kingdom of God. And we declare that this morning, this very morning marks a shift in the spiritual atmosphere over every life represented here. We speak to every demonic assignment. We speak to every evil covenant. We speak to every curse that has been spoken. We speak to every altar that has been erected against these lives. We say to you, your time is up. Your assignment is broken. [music] Your power is nullified in the name of Jesus. Your authority over these lives is revoked. We decree that the blood of Jesus stands between these lives and every assault of the enemy. We decree that the cross of Calvary has disqualified every demonic claim. We decree that the resurrection of Jesus [music] has established the authority of these believers over all the forces of darkness. We call forth the angel of the Lord. We call for the archangel Michael. We call forth the host of heaven. We speak to you in the name of Jesus Christ. Stand up. Take your position. Fight on behalf of these lives. Dismantle every assignment. Break every covenant. Destroy every altar. Confound every plan of the enemy. I speak to the gatekeepers of blessing. I speak to the keepers of destiny. I command you in the name of Jesus, open every gate, release every [music] blessing, establish every pathway, let the promotion flow, let the healing [music] flow, let the prosperity flow. Let divine favor overwhelm every opposition. We bind every spirit of oppression in the morning hours. We bind every spirit that tries to steal peace before your feet hit the floor. We bind every spirit of anxiety, depression, heaviness, and despair in the name of Jesus Christ. We cast you down. We cast you out. You have no authority here. You have no access here. You have no power here. The blood of Jesus forbids your approach. We release the power of the resurrection. We release the power that was demonstrated when Jesus rose from the dead. We release the power that rolled away the stone. We release the power that opened the way. We release the power that breaks every chain. Someone under the sound of my voice, the Lord says, "Your grave has been opened. Every burial that has been spoken over your life, it is void. Every death sentence that has been pronounced, it is overturned. Every grave where your destiny has been placed, it is unsealed. Your resurrection is now. Your rising is now. Your advancement is now. I speak to the financial gates, gates of opportunity, gates of increase, gates of abundance. I command you in the name of Jesus Christ, open, release the wealth of the wicked into the hands of the righteous. Release the resources that belong to the covenant people. Break every embargo. Break every blockade. Break every barrier. Someone is getting a financial turnaround this very week. Someone is receiving a phone call that changes everything. Someone is walking into an opportunity that they were not even looking for. The Lord says your economic situation is about to shift. What has [clears throat] been withheld will be released. What has been held back will flow. What the enemy tried to contain will overflow. I decree and declare by the power of the blood of Jesus, every witchcraft assignment is broken. Every evil eye that has been cast upon your life is blinded. Every hex that has been spoken is nullified. Every anointing of darkness that has been released is reversed in the name of Jesus. Witchcraft has no power here. Sorcery has no access here. Every form of darkness loses its grip. There is a woman under the sound of my voice. The Lord is saying your womb is opening. The barness is breaking. The curse on your bloodline is severed. Whatever was meant to stop you from carrying life, it is reversed. The medical report does not define you. The years do not disqualify you. The Lord is opening a door that no man can shut. Prepare your heart. Receive your miracle. There is a man who is hearing this. You have been fighting a battle that you could not name. There has been a heaviness in your family. There has been a cycle that repeats itself. There has been an assignment to shipwreck your destiny. But the Lord is breaking that cycle now. The bloodline curse is severed. The generational assignment is dismantled. The pattern is broken. Your children will not inherit what your fathers inherited. A new legacy begins with you. I speak to the marriage altars. I speak to the families that are under assault. I speak to the relationships that the enemy is trying to destroy. I say this, the covenant will stand. The union will be preserved. The love will be restored. What the enemy meant to sever the blood of Jesus is sealing. What the enemy meant to break, the grace of God is mending. What the enemy meant to corrupt, the Holy Ghost is purifying. There is a couple who is on the edge of separation. The Lord is saying, "Turn around. Come back. I am not finished with this union." The pain you are experiencing is not the end. This is the test before the testimony.
